name: Setsu Getsu Yawa
source:
"Saniwa"—those who discern the truth of a god during a divine summoning ritual.

Mizuchi Seishirou had been training relentlessly to become a Saniwa.
But then, news reached him: Kamikura Mao, the daughter of Kuki Shrine, had failed a divine summoning ritual and was acting strangely.

Rushing back to his hometown, he found Mao—her speech and behavior regressed to that of a child.
If she wasn’t awakened within five days, her body would perish…
There was only one way to save her: the Secret Rite of the Saniwa.
He couldn’t lose her—his childhood friend, his precious little sister… Mao.
Holding onto the promise they made as children, Seishirou set up a barrier in the inner sanctum of Kuki Shrine and secluded himself with Mao.

Within the prison of emotions that had eroded both humans and gods for centuries—
The intimate bond between Seishirou and Mao was about to begin.


[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ017627.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
“三庭”——在神圣召唤仪式中辨别神的真实性的人。

水星四郎一直在坚持不懈地训练，以成为桑庭人。
但就在这时，他收到了消息：九鬼神社的女儿神仓真央在一次神召仪式上失败了，行为异常。

赶回家乡后，他发现了毛泽东，她的言行举止都退化成了小孩子的样子。
五天内若不觉醒，她的肉身就会消亡……
只有一种方法可以拯救她：萨尼瓦的秘密仪式。
他不能失去她——他的青梅竹马，他的宝贝妹妹……毛。
星史郎秉承儿时的约定，在久喜神社的内殿设置了结界，与真绪一起隔离。

在数个世纪以来侵蚀人类和神灵的情感牢狱之中——
星史郎和毛泽东之间的亲密关系即将开始。
